description: Returns the latest rates for one or more commodity symbols (e.g. gold, silver, crude oil). Rates may lag up to 10 minutes depending on plan. Use 'quote' to convert to a specific currency (Premium/Plus plans only). Common names with a single match (e.g. GOLD) are auto-resolved to the real symbol and flagged in 'unresolved' with 'resolvedTo'. Set 'metadata' to false to omit the per-symbol unit/quote map.

metadata.description: Whether to include the 'metadata' map (per-symbol unit and quote currency) in the response. Defaults to true. Set false to omit it and get a smaller payload.

quote.description: Target quote currency code (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR'). Premium/Plus plans only; omit to use each symbol's default currency.

symbols.description: Comma-separated commodity symbols, e.g. 'XAU,XAG,XPT,BRENTOIL-SPOT'. Precious metals use ISO 4217 codes (XAU gold, XAG silver, XPT platinum, XPD palladium); copper is XCU. See the list_symbols tool for valid values. The response may include an 'unresolved' map keyed by the symbol you typed. Three cases: (1) HTTP 200 with an entry carrying 'resolvedTo' — the symbol was not a catalogue code but had exactly one match (e.g. GOLD -> XAU, retired PL -> XPT), so its rate was returned under the 'resolvedTo' symbol in 'rates'; this is informational, not a failure. (2) HTTP 206 — some symbols could not be returned; each entry has a message and, where available, 'did you mean' suggestions, while the valid rates are still in 'rates'. (3) If none resolve, the error result carries the same 'unresolved' map.

name: get_latest_rates
title: Get latest commodity rates
